scope: Native lattice decimation, lightening cells, spatial graph, planar lightening and FDM print-settings fitting
coverage: Decimation is deterministic: identical positions and indices for a fixed input
A subdivided closed box decimates to the requested target and stays closed, oriented and valid
Default 2600 target applies; the cumulative-radius tolerance guard stops collapse early
Edge-collapse fold rejection keeps output closed where the input was closed
Malformed meshes (non-finite coordinates, out-of-range indices) refuse without mutation
Negative/NaN tolerance and negative/NaN target refuse at native admission
Print fitting reproduces legacy nozzle/layer quantization bit-for-bit (1e-8 epsilon, 112.5% line width, 1e6 compaction)
Spatial skin/step resolution, floor snapping, open-top and idempotent refit match pre-migration results
Bridge warning matches the legacy cell-minus-rib comparison
Non-finite or out-of-range print settings refuse with the legacy user-facing message
Spatial graph fixtures, component counting and planar lightening regressions still pass
Workbench per-body lightening orchestration still passes against the native kernels
behaviorChange: Lattice decimation now rejects negative or non-finite tolerance at admission instead of silently returning the unchanged mesh or collapsing without a radius guard. fitLatticeToPrint now rejects missing or non-finite lattice cell/rib/bottom/top/rim options instead of propagating NaN into the fitted result. printBridgeWarning no longer warns on non-numeric transport values.
limitations: The per-body lighten host loop in cadWorkbench.ts remains TS bookkeeping, applying the native cad_lightening op body by body
CadWorkbenchPanel.vue still computes the volume-reduction percentage for the info line as presentation formatting
Fold checks during decimation are local triangle orientation checks, not global self-intersection certification
No browser peak-memory qualification was performed for the decimation heap
General B-rep completion and the remaining Rust migration are open
